sections.title: Frequently Asked Questions Meta Ads Agency in Indore

items.q: What is a Meta Ads agency and what do they do?
items.a: A Meta Ads agency manages Facebook and Instagram advertising campaigns on behalf of businesses. This includes strategy, audience targeting, creative production, campaign setup, ongoing optimisation, and performance reporting. The goal is to generate leads, sales, or brand awareness at a cost that makes commercial sense.

items.q: How much does it cost to run Meta Ads in India?
items.a: Meta Ads budgets are flexible. Many of our clients in Indore start with ₹10,000 to ₹20,000 per month in ad spend. The agency management fee is separate from your ad budget. What matters more than budget size is how efficiently that budget is managed a well-run ₹15,000 campaign consistently outperforms a poorly managed ₹50,000 one.

items.q: How quickly will I see results from Facebook Ads?
items.a: Unlike SEO, which builds over months, Meta Ads can generate leads or sales within 48 to 72 hours of launching a well-built campaign. That said, meaningful optimisation and consistent results typically develop over the first 2 to 4 weeks as the algorithm learns and we refine based on data.

items.q: Do you run Instagram Ads separately from Facebook Ads?
items.a: In Meta's Ads Manager, Facebook and Instagram placements are managed within the same campaign structure. We can run campaigns across both platforms simultaneously or isolate specific placements based on your audience and objectives. Most of our clients benefit from running across both.

items.q: What's the difference between boosting a post and running a proper Meta Ads campaign?
items.a: Boosting a post is a simplified tool with very limited targeting and objective options. A proper Meta Ads campaign built in Ads Manager gives you full control over objectives, audiences, placements, creative formats, bidding, and optimisation. A properly structured campaign almost always delivers significantly lower cost-per-result.

items.q: Do I need a website to run Meta Ads?
items.a: Not always. For lead generation campaigns using Meta's native lead forms, you don't need a website. However, for traffic and conversion campaigns, a well-built landing page makes a significant difference to results. Our website development team can build or optimise those pages as part of a broader campaign setup.

items.q: Can Meta Ads help local businesses in Indore specifically?
items.a: Absolutely. Meta's location targeting lets us reach people within a specific radius of your business in Indore, or target the entire city and surrounding areas of Madhya Pradesh. For local service businesses, this hyper-local targeting is one of Meta's strongest advantages.

items.q: How do I know my ad budget is being spent properly?
items.a: You retain full ownership of your Meta Ads account at all times. We never run campaigns from our own account on your behalf. You can see every rupee spent in real time, and we provide monthly reports covering spend, results, and cost-per-outcome in plain language.
